name: Vsyo budet khorosho
source:
"I am tired of your emptiness,
That seeps from fiery eyes.
You sit and stay silent right into my soul -
The most worn-down red diamond.
You want to sing, you and Cupid again
Have prepared a warm tale for me.
How can I not love you,
How can I die with you,
How can I believe in you to accept my conscience?
Turn your head to the cluster of stars, let the sky suffer with me too.
Even there, the earth fades from you.
Even there, you won't find your personal peace.
We filled everything at hand with the eloquence of the night.
Don't be sad, I love you even like this,
And let them find their own special peace.
I will warm your sleep with a very warm cheek.
Go to sleep,
My beautiful hero."

Semyon sees the pioneer girls dying one by one. He always ends up in the exact same place the moment he falls asleep. He doesn't even remember exactly when he woke up today, or what he was doing for the past few hours.
Only torn, dirty traces of memories.
But he is here, he is alone, and he must do what he has to do.
And he will still do everything wrong...

Despite the concept, this is a very warm story. It tells the tale of the long and thorny path of a person who, time and time again, loses something dear, becoming something else.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2917637321]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“我厌倦了你的空虚，
那是从火热的眼睛里渗出来的。
你坐着，保持沉默，直达我的灵魂——
最磨损的红钻。
你想唱歌，你和丘比特再次
为我准备了一个温暖的故事。
我怎能不爱你
我怎么能和你一起死
我怎样才能相信你接受我的良心呢？
把头转向星团，让天空也跟着我受苦吧。
即使在那里，大地也会从你身边消失。
即使在那里，你也找不到个人的平静。
我们用夜晚的雄辩充满了手头的一切。
别伤心，即使这样我也爱你
并让他们找到属于自己的特别的平静。
我会用非常温暖的脸颊温暖你的睡眠。
去睡觉吧，
我美丽的英雄。”

谢苗看到拓荒女孩们一一死去。当他睡着的那一刻，他总是会回到同一个地方。他甚至不记得自己今天什么时候醒来，也不记得过去几个小时自己在做什么。
只有撕碎的、肮脏的记忆痕迹。
但他在这里，他孤身一人，他必须做他必须做的事。
他仍然会做错一切……

尽管有这个概念，但这仍然是一个非常温暖的故事。它讲述了一个人一次又一次失去珍贵的东西并成为其他东西的漫长而荆棘之路的故事。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2917637321]Steam[/url]]
